settings.text: We ship worldwide from Printful's US + EU hubs. Pre-order sweaters knit in 7 business days, with delivery windows of 3-5 days (US) and 5-10 days (EU).

• US: UPS Ground, DHL eCommerce. Free over $75.
  • Canada: Tracked postal service, duties calculated at checkout.
  • EU/UK: Localized printing via Riga & Barcelona hubs for zero customs surprises.
Returns: 60-day window, free exchanges, prepaid labels in US. Email support@uglyglow.com for international assistance.
